question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different. The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) NPRS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f62789bc892d34defb6eee36f872a453a458bd5b3536155599e6128b054502f4.png] 

Option 2) KMOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7850be153aa83ac5ba23eec1a4bbb9f91cec8b83a6f4526e87b9cc49fcaa7bef.png] 

**Option 3) UVXW**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4a505eb88fcf555211d9b34ae9a1ca91a242ead821e643e5ea2538106682800.png] 

Option 4) EGIJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdd7acaf332ca80502b8a49bf12f52bb886202b73ba219437ba949f42fb00171.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "UVXW".**
